def transform(grid):
    # Extract the bounding box of the 8-pattern, then repeat it twice horizontally.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    pattern = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    return [row + row for row in pattern]
